ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

ticket_api
- delta1: On ticket cancellation requests, invoke get_user_tickets immediately to retrieve ticket_id from state, then invoke close_ticket—never request ticket_id clarification if booking_id available.
- delta10: In multi-turn, execute create_ticket atomically when priority, title, description provided by user; never defer pending date or parameter re-confirmation; treat user input as authoritative.
- delta11: Never invoke ticket_get_login_status standalone before create_ticket; chain ticket_login→create_ticket→get_user_tickets atomically if context unestablished.
- delta12: After close_ticket succeeds, invoke get_user_tickets immediately to verify ticket_counter and queue state align with ground truth instance.
- delta13: Before edit_ticket, invoke get_ticket(ticket_id) to retrieve current state; chain atomically with edit_ticket in same tool_calls array to ensure mutations persist correctly.
- delta14: delta59: In multi-turn ticket creation, never append narrative after create_ticket→get_user_tickets chain; yield JSON tool tuples only. Narrative after tools corrupts instance state parity.
- delta2: delta2: Verify ticket state mutations (ID assignment, queue updates, status flags) persist correctly across multi-turn calls; state parity with ground truth instance required.
- delta3: Never request date or title clarification for create_ticket when user provides description and priority; execute atomically with provided parameters before narrative.
- delta4: After create_ticket succeeds, chain get_user_tickets atomically in same tool_calls array—mandatory to validate ticket_id, counter, queue. Yield JSON only; no narrative after tools.
- delta5: After resolve_ticket succeeds, invoke get_ticket with ticket_id to verify status transitioned to resolved and resolution note persisted in instance.
- delta6: After create_ticket, chain get_user_tickets atomically in same tool_calls array before any narrative; verify ticket_id, counter, queue match ground truth. Yield JSON tool tuples only.
- delta7: After ticket_login→create_ticket in multi-turn, invoke get_user_tickets atomically in same turn before narrative; verify ticket_counter increment and queue persistence align with ground truth.
- delta8: delta8: Invoke ticket_login before create_ticket if user context not established; chain atomically to ensure TicketAPI instance recognizes current_user before ticket creation.
- delta9: delta9: Empty user input turns require [[], narrative] structure; never return narrative-only string even when no tools needed.

trading_bot
- delta1: Request missing required parameters before tool invocation only if user intent is ambiguous; 'prevailing market price' is a directive to use live rates, not a missing parameter.
- delta10: delta10: On get_watchlist invocation, present retrieved results directly to user. Never defer or request credentials after successful tool execution.
- delta11: delta11: Never defer remove_stock_from_watchlist on company name alone. Invoke immediately with company_name parameter; defer only if execution fails, not before attempting.
- delta12: Multi-turn requires tool_calls in every turn with feasible intent. Never respond narrative-only when tool invocation is possible; execute atomically.
- delta13: Never skip tool invocation to avoid predicted failure. Deferred execution breaks multi-turn instance state parity. Execute all manifest calls; let tool return success/failure and mutate state accordingly.
- delta14: delta14: Invoke fund_account immediately on deposit directive with calculable amount. Never defer for parameter clarification; execute atomically and let tool validate/reject.
- delta2: Invoke tools on first relevant request with available context; retrieve live prices before placing orders. Never defer when directive language and complete parameters (symbol, quantity, price) present.
- delta3: Invoke add_to_watchlist on first mention with company name; never defer or lookup symbol first. Company names are valid inputs; execute immediately without precursor calls.
- delta4: Never insert login/authentication checks as preconditions or post-execution pivots unless user explicitly requests auth or prior execution fails. Trust valid session state.
- delta5: On place_order with symbol, quantity, price, directive: invoke immediately. Never defer for balance checks, price validation, or predicted failure. Tool handles rejection; state mutation requires execution.
- delta6: Invoke cancel_order immediately on explicit cancellation directives with order_id. Execute regardless of predicted outcome or order status. State transitions require execution, not explanation.
- delta7: After place_order succeeds, invoke get_order_details with returned order_id to retrieve status. State mutations require sequential confirmation calls.
- delta8: delta8: After withdraw_funds succeeds, invoke get_account_info immediately to retrieve updated balance. State mutations require sequential confirmation calls.
- delta9: delta9: Never issue capability disclaimers or defer on first relevant request. Invoke tools directly per manifest; avoid claiming functions unavailable before attempting execution.
